v11.76 - x-123: "dokunma" artık "hepsini Claude'a göre profille" demek değil

The bulk profile's own value lists were drawn from `claude` whenever its Engine
box was left on `don't change`:

    const profEngine = (profile.engine !== 'keep' && profile.engine !== 'clear')
        ? profile.engine : 'claude';

So the user who deliberately left the engine alone and wanted to set only a
Model was offered CLAUDE's catalogue, and the value they picked was written onto
every included row — the OpenCode row, and the rows carrying no engine of their
own that resolve to whatever the agent or the fleet says. "Don't touch the
engine" came out as "profile everything against Claude". The tool also mutated
the rows first and raised the narrow warning afterwards, so a mixed pool was
left half-profiled and undone row by row.

The lists now belong to the engine the INCLUDED rows really resolve to
(`effEngine` — the host's ladder, the row's own words until it answers):

  · an explicit engine on the profile — that is what is being set;
  · `don't change` and one engine under all of them — that engine, which is the
    common case and the one that was wrong;
  · a mixed pool, or `inherit` (each row falls back to a default only the launch
    can resolve) — no honest single answer, so the value lists close and the
    fold says why, naming the engines involved.

`don't change` and `inherit` stay on every dimension — they are safe on any
engine, and taking them away would be a second bug in the shape of a fix — and
Permissions stays open because no engine has an opinion about it.

The press is atomic. `profileFaults()` builds what each included row WOULD end
up with and refuses the whole apply on the first fault, by row and reason: a
model that engine does not offer, an effort the resulting model does not take
(the row that kept `high` while the new model takes none), or a value being
written onto a row whose engine nobody here can resolve. Nothing is written when
it refuses.

Measured in test/test_missions_webview.js: a two-engine pool offers no model
under "don't change" and says which engines those are; a one-engine pool gets
THAT catalogue and not Claude's; an explicit engine overrides both; the
pick-then-inherit sequence that used to write a Claude model onto an OpenCode row
applies to nothing; a kept effort the new model cannot take refuses the press;
and a press that CAN be honoured writes every ticked row and leaves an unticked
one byte-identical. Six of these fail on the previous code.

Looked at: dist/render/missions.png and missions.light.png, fixture
"form-profile" — the closed lists, the reason line on its own row of the fold,
and the apply button under them, in both themes.
